llm.reply:
The retrieved records link cystic fibrosis to three genes. The first is NCBIGene:1080, CF transmembrane conductance regulator [1]. The second is NCBIGene:2212, Fc gamma receptor IIa [3]. The third is NCBIGene:7040, transforming growth factor beta 1 [4].

## Disease Record

The associated condition is Cystic fibrosis [2]. The MedGen concept is titled Cystic fibrosis [6]. PubTator3 also normalizes the literature entity Cystic Fibrosis [7].

## Clinical Features

MedGen lists Bronchiectasis as a clinical feature [15]. Hemoptysis is also listed [28]. Clubbing of fingers appears among the features [19]. Hepatomegaly is recorded as well [29].

## Literature and Trials

Liver disease is a common problem in cystic fibrosis, but brain dysfunction arising from it is uncommon [26: "Cystic fibrosis liver disease (CFLD) affects a large proportion of cystic fibrosis (CF) patients; however encephalopathy is a rare complication"]. Hyperammonemic encephalopathy can be triggered by steroids in patients whose liver disease was previously stable [26: "can be precipitated in previously stable CFLD by various triggers including systemic corticosteroids"]. One registered trial is titled Assessment of Quadriceps Muscle Electrostimulation Used in Patients Suffering From Cystic Fibrosis [8]. Another trial is titled Pregnancies and Cystic Fibrosis [24].

One cystic fibrosis trial is Assessment of Quadriceps Muscle Electrostimulation Used in Patients Suffering From Cystic Fibrosis [8]. Another is Pregnancies and Cystic Fibrosis [24]. Another is Efficacy and Safety of ONCOXIN in Patients With Breast Fibrocystic Disease [16]. Another is A Clinical Study on the Efficacy and Safety of the Treatment of Hyperplasia of Mammary Glands With Xiaoru Sanjie Capsule [20].
